turns.text: But sometimes, doesn't that feel a little weird or rude?
turns.zh: 但有时候，你不觉得那有点怪或者有点没礼貌吗？

turns.text: If a stranger asks, "Can I use your phone?" and you say yes, you wouldn't say great.
turns.zh: 如果一个陌生人问「我能用一下你的手机吗？」你答应了，你也不会觉得这有什么好高兴的。

turns.text: Now, can you also buy me a coffee?
turns.zh: 那，你能再给我买杯咖啡吗？
